children.textContent: Nine services, one New York crew. Pick one to see what is in it.
OLED TVs, touchscreens with Android or Windows built in, transparent displays and multi-screen playback stations.
OLED TVs on floor stands or mounts, delivered and set up for booths, lounges and stages.
Touch displays with Android or Windows built in, on a stand or as a kiosk, running your app or one we build.
See-through screens that put motion graphics in front of a real product.
Screens on truss or stands with players and a control position, looping content for the whole run.
LED video walls go up with the same crew. Sizes, specs and pricing are on our LED site.
Epson laser projectors up to 7,000 lumens for events, trade shows and immersive exhibitions, mapping on any surface, and home theater.
7,000-lumen Epson laser projectors, lenses and screens for events, trade shows and immersive exhibitions, hung and aligned by us.
Content fitted to walls, objects, sets and architecture, including irregular and sculptural surfaces.
A projector, screen and sound at home: rented for a night or installed for good.
Sound systems, wireless microphones, directional speakers, spatial audio and haptic seating.
Line arrays, subs and fills sized to the space, with an engineer at the console.
Handheld, lavalier and headset wireless for panels, presenters and performers.
Sound that stays in one spot: the person underneath hears it, the person beside them does not. To rent or to buy.
Sound placed around the audience, and seating that moves with the low end.
Consoles and the audio engineers who run them, with our system or yours.
Aputure lighting, stage decks, truss and rigging, and the stage work around them.
Aputure fixtures for stages, spaces and camera, placed, focused and run by us.
Modular stage decks in the size and height the job needs, built and levelled.
Ground-supported and flown truss for lights, screens, speakers and projectors.
A lighting desk and an operator for the show.
Live streaming, switchers and production kits, and VJ and Resolume visuals.
Cameras, encoding and a crew to put the event online.
Video switchers and portable production kits, rented with or without an operator.
Live and audio-reactive visuals, playback and show control. If Resolume does it, we do it.
Remote speakers and remote audiences in the same show as the audience on site.
UniFi networks for events and for buildings, and computers and workstations to rent or own.
A UniFi network brought in for the event: access points, switching and someone watching it.
UniFi networks designed, installed and handed over in your space.
Workstations and show computers for the run of the event.
Workstations built to order, to buy.
TouchDesigner, sensors, RFID, motion capture and the 3D content that reacts to them.
Floors, walls and whole spaces that respond to people, built in TouchDesigner.
Cameras and sensors that follow people without anything worn.
Full-body motion capture and tracking, rented, installed and run for live shows, installs and capture sessions.
Tap an object or a badge and the space responds.
3D modeling and real-time content that follows the performer or the visitor.
Custom builds, branded pieces and pop-up shops, designed, 3D-printed and assembled in house, with the screens, light and sound already built in.
One-off pieces made for the job: housings, plinths, props and mounts.
A branded unit that arrives finished, with display, light and sound inside it.
Pieces printed at furniture scale, and small-batch runs on the print farm.
We case it, truck it and load it in ourselves. For work outside New York, the same crew travels with the gear.
Our truck and our crew, from our dock to your door and back.
The same system and the same people in every city on the run.
Rent it, buy it, have it installed,
Delivered, set up, run and struck by our crew.
Displays, projectors, directional speakers, network equipment and computers, supplied and configured.
Permanent systems for offices, venues, galleries, retail and homes, with the network underneath.
Audio, video and lighting technicians for a show that already has its equipment.
One team, from the first call to the last case.
Tell us where, when and what has to happen. Drawings and references help.
Equipment, crew and delivery on one quote.
Content, programming and custom pieces are made before the truck is loaded.
Our truck, our cases, our crew. We set up, test and stay to run it.
We take it down and take it away. Installs are handed over working.
Do you rent, sell or install?

All three. Most equipment can be rented for an event. Displays, projectors, directional speakers, network equipment and computers can also be bought. We install permanent systems in offices, venues, galleries, retail and homes.
Can we hire only the crew?
Yes. We send audio, video and lighting technicians to shows that already have their equipment.
Do you work outside New York?
Yes. We are based in Brooklyn, New York, and the same crew travels with the equipment.
Yes. We design and fabricate custom pieces and pop-up units with the screens, light and sound built in, and we run large-format 3D printing through
What if we need something that is not listed?
We source it and integrate it with the rest of the system.
Start with what you need and when.
Tell us where, when, how many people and what has to happen. We reply with one quote for equipment, crew and delivery.
